execution_boundary: Prospective design only. No participant contact, data acquisition, task deployment, recruitment, consent, or external communication was executed.
common_hard_gates: canonical source custody for each load-bearing novelty comparator
versioned task implementation with exact event logging
pre-registered positive control, negative control, exclusion, and kill criterion
independent audit of exact-state and action-coordinate logging

finalist_packets.minimum_world_contact_design: Within-solver 2x2 perturbation experiment: preserve/destroy subgoal boundary crossed with a matched perturbation topology. Record exact state, action stream, latency, repair route, and declared subgoal phase.
finalist_packets.positive_control: A perturbation intentionally preserving the active subgoal has shorter local repair than a matched boundary-destroying perturbation.
finalist_packets.negative_control: A motor interruption with no state perturbation does not reproduce the boundary-specific repair pattern.
finalist_packets.fatal_result: After matching state distance, elapsed time, and motor interruption, the preregistered interaction is absent or fully accounted for by a non-plan rival.

finalist_packets.minimum_world_contact_design: Factorial physical-frame switch × action-label remap × plan-continuity protocol, with exact task state and move-coordinate logs.
finalist_packets.positive_control: The known spatial-switch manipulation shifts the spatial component when labels and continuity are held fixed.
finalist_packets.negative_control: A label-preserving no-remap switch does not mimic the action-coordinate effect.
finalist_packets.fatal_result: All factors collapse to a single generic rotation/familiarity effect or factorial implementation fails manipulation checks.

finalist_packets.minimum_world_contact_design: Longitudinal solver cohort with exact state/move/latency records, preregistered change-point detector, independent transfer session, and practice-dose logs.
finalist_packets.positive_control: A known taught chunk transition is detected at a protocol-defined acquisition point.
finalist_packets.negative_control: Synthetic smooth-rate trajectories do not trigger the discrete-transition rule at the specified false-positive rate.
finalist_packets.fatal_result: All transitions disappear under preregistered practice, baseline ability, and motor-speed controls or fail held-out transfer.
